question: Should this repository enroll the public comment-triggered ClawSweeper caller only after an immutable workflow revision and credential-free execution boundary are demonstrated?
rationale: The acceptable trust boundary for public comment content, runner credentials, and centrally managed workflow updates requires repository-owner approval rather than a mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Hold enrollment pending isolation proof
options.body: Keep the caller unmerged until the reusable workflow is pinned and a credential-free allowlisted runner or container passes an adversarial canary.

options.title: Approve hardened enrollment
options.body: Authorize a revised caller after reviewing the immutable workflow revision, its authorization path, and successful isolated runtime proof.

options.title: Accept rolling central updates
options.body: Allow the `@main` delegation and current runner model only if the repository owner explicitly accepts their security and automation risk.

recommendation.title: Hold enrollment pending isolation proof
recommendation.body: Keep the caller unmerged until the reusable workflow is pinned and a credential-free allowlisted runner or container passes an adversarial canary.
